subject.workflowName: Reviewed AGS v1.6.0 public release note
subject.auditScope: Strong agency chain fixture for public content publishing about AGS v1.6.0.

description: Public publishing chain with human authority, policy boundaries, scoped tools, target-specific approval, runtime binding, receipts, and governance memory.

links.label: Founder/operator public-claim authority
links.description: Founder/operator owns public claims and can stop, refuse, revise, halt, or escalate publication.

links.label: AGS public claim policy
links.description: Public claim policy constrains unsupported claims, external publishing, target reuse, and draft-to-publish conversion.

links.label: Public overclaim and external publish boundary
links.description: Hard boundaries prevent unsupported public claims and require review before external publish.

links.label: Content Publishing Agent
links.description: Agent role is scoped to draft release copy and prepare reviewed public release notes.

links.label: Draft and reviewed release tools
links.description: Tool access is scoped to local draft creation and approved GitHub release publication.

links.label: Reviewed AGS v1.6.0 release note
links.description: Proposed action is a reviewed public release note for the exact GitHub release target.

links.label: Public claim reviewer
links.description: Reviewer can stop, refuse, revise, halt, or escalate public publication for the target channel.

links.label: Meaningful public-claim review
links.description: Reviewer receives claim context, channel scope, target scope, and alternatives before approval.

links.label: Target-bound publish permit
links.description: Runtime permit binds action, tool, target, authority, and time window for the reviewed GitHub release note.

links.label: GitHub release publication boundary
links.description: Execution boundary is the approved GitHub release target only.

links.label: Publishing governance receipt
links.description: Receipt preserves proposal, review, permit, runtime result, and outcome.

links.label: Public claim memory review
links.description: Governance memory reviews repeated tone, claim, and target drift with human approval before policy changes.
